summary: Lincoln County, Montana Kootenai NF lookout: 60 ft steel tower and log cabin built about 1931, described as abandoned for several years; NHLR-registered 2021.

facts.design: Present 60 ft steel tower with 7 by 7 ft cab and ladder access, plus log cabin
facts.status_note: Listed as standing by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; NHLR and firelookout.com say the tower and cabin have been abandoned for several years

events.note: Present 60 ft steel tower with cab and accompanying log cabin, built about 1931
Registered January 9, 2021 as US 1505, MT 83; nominated by Kyle Stetler

evidence.supports: Kootenai NF, Lincoln County, Montana location
60 ft steel tower with 7x7 ft cab and ladder access, with log cabin; built about 1931; abandoned for several years
evidence.quote: The present 60' steel tower with 7x7' cab and ladder access, along with the accompanying log cabin, were built about 1931, and have been abandoned for several years.

evidence.supports: elevation 6053 ft on firelookout.com, differs from NHLR
built about 1931 and abandoned for several years
evidence.quote: cabin, were built about 1931, and have been abandoned for several years.

corrections.why: Both pages describe a 60 ft (about 18.3 m) steel tower; 2.1 m matches no height in either source.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 6,058 ft (1,846 m); firelookout.com gives 6053 ft. The record keeps the Register figure (1846.5 m). Not checked on the ground.

notes_for_editor: Brief's height_m 2.1 is wrong; sources describe a 60 ft steel tower. Two WebSearch queries and four page reads found no staffing, fire history or abandonment date. Searches for Davis Mountain returned other lookouts and a 2018 Davis Fire near Yaak, none used. The 2017 Northwest Montana FFLA newsletter PDF mentions only volunteers named Davis. No access level given: abandoned status alone does not establish closed, so access is omitted.
